Title: Storage Analytics logs for Azure Data Lake Storage are now generally available

Body.Content:
Announcing the general availability of Storage Analytics logs for Azure Data Lake Storage which can help monitor storage operations and diagnose issues. These logs provide detailed information about successful as well as failed requests. Logs are available for Azure Data Lake Storage operations and Blob operations as documented here.   

Learn more about Storage Analytics logs.
